tldr: Mars through the 11th house heats up friends, groups, community, networks, and future plans.
body:
When Mars moves through your 11th house, it adds heat and urgency to friends, groups, audience, networks, community, hopes, and where you belong. You may notice who you are connected to, which groups still feel alive, and what kind of future you want to be part of.

You may feel more impatient, motivated, protective, desirous, or ready to act. It can help you move something that has been stuck.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for seeing where belonging supports you and where it has become performative.

The caution: Watch for reacting before you know what you are actually trying to change. The risk is staying attached to a group, plan, or audience that no longer fits.

Mars moves through this house for about six weeks. Give the pressure a useful outlet. Act with a target, not just a charge.
